verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review platform with an MCP server and an Analytics API, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. However, no evidence shows that it issues scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for agents. The only related item is user role-based access control for subscription and settings changes, which is an adjacent control rather than scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
